title: Mihomo Control
failure.stop health check rejected: Stop health check could not start
failure.health check cancelled: API wait cancelled; service remains running
failure.service stopped before API ready: Service stopped before its API was ready
failure.helper status rejected: Helper status request could not start
automatic_group: Automatic group; selection is managed by Mihomo
offline_hint: Check the local controller at 127.0.0.1, the port and secret. Lifecycle buttons appear only when an external helper is configured.
stopped_hint: The service is off. Start it when you need the local controller.
starting_hint: Mihomo may need time to initialize data. You can cancel this wait without stopping the service.
settings.secret_description: Optional bearer token; kept in your Noctalia settings, never in this repository.
settings.helper_description: Optional absolute path to a host supplied status/start/stop/restart helper.
settings.profile_helper_description: Optional host supplied helper for listing, importing and activating local profiles.
profile_import_hint: Import a local YAML file without activating it. Paste an absolute path.
profile_imported: Profile imported; activate it when ready
profile_path_invalid: Enter an absolute local file path
profile_import_failed: Import failed; current profile was not changed
profile_activate_failed: Activation failed; check the current profile
profile_invalid: Profile validation failed; current profile was not changed
profile_unreadable: Source file could not be read
profile_rollback_failed: Activation and rollback failed; inspect the host service
profile_invalid_response: Profile helper returned an invalid response
profile_activation_unconfirmed: Helper did not confirm the selected profile; inspect the host state
profile_import_unconfirmed: Imported profile is missing from the host list
profile_timeout: Profile operation timed out; refresh to inspect its result
